verdict.rationale: The Division documents a fax-filing rail and names paper forms such as CD-100/CD-101, so a non-portal fallback exists. However, the fax route is itself presented as an online 'modernized application', and no exact mailing address, fax number, or full form set is published in the evidence. Missing for 10: published mailing address, explicit fax number, complete list of paper forms per filing type, and guidance on using the fallback when the online flow is down.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: To submit a fax filing, use our modernized application: New Jersey Fax Filing.
CD-100 For use when resulting business will be a NJ Entity; CD-101 For use when resulting business will be a non-NJ Foreign Entity
